content.short: Theo Network builds institutional tokenized products including thBILL, thGOLD and thUSD.
content.description: Theo builds tokenized institutional products including thBILL for Treasury bills, thGOLD for gold and thUSD as a dollar instrument. Its stated aim is deep trading liquidity so investors can enter and exit at size, efficient leverage for capital efficiency, and composability so derivatives can be built on top. The team comes from market making, hedge fund quant work and crypto engineering. The products are being rolled out progressively, with Monad among the supported chains.
